caption: The drawing features two distinct objects on a plain, off-white background. The top object is an elongated, asymmetrical tool or implement with a wide, rounded end that looks like a sling or cradle, narrowing into a straight handle that ends in a flat, oval loop. It is shaded in brown tones with darker accents, suggesting a metallic or wooden material. Below, there are two separate, curved items, each resembling a bent tube or thick wire, drawn in shades of light brown and tan. One is U-shaped with straight ends while the other forms an inverted arc. The composition is minimal, with ample negative space separating the objects, and the artist's name, "Elizabeth Johnson," appears in small print at the lower right.
title: Branding Iron
